name: "Diggertron" 1:1 Replica Model
description: Upon use, increases Fire DMG of all allies by 16% for the next battle.
story:
It's hard to explain why Hook is so beloved in Astropolis. Aetherium Wars hasn't been the hottest game in years, and Hook was never the most popular player to begin with, yet the people of Astropolis just can't get enough of her. Maybe she represents something pure, something the steel-and-concrete jungle of Astropolis can no longer offer.

"I mean, Pitch-Dark Hook the Great, you're practically a celebrity in Astropolis! Come with me sometime, and the people will line the streets to welcome you with open arms. The whole city, yours for the taking!"
"Sampo, if you keep filling the kid's head with this nonsense, I'm going to smack that mouth of yours."
